name: Major cyber incidents
value: USDA breach took systems offline 19 Nov
summary: A security breach forced USDA to take farm payment systems offline from 16 Nov; no national-scale attack found
state: USDA reset all database passwords after its security operations centre found an intrusion, taking farm payment tools, loan-status applications and some staff VPN access offline, with outages expected through the week of 16 Nov; the attacker and any data theft were not known (Nextgov, 19 Nov). Vanderbilt University disabled its Microsoft services after a cyber incident on 17 Nov, and CISA added exploited VMware vCenter, SAP and Cisco flaws to its catalogue on 20 Nov (IBTimes; CISA). Disruption to a federal payments service keeps Watch; no national-scale attack was found.
for_you: Organisations should follow NCSC and CISA advisories and patch flaws on CISA's known-exploited list. US farmers using USDA online services may face delays to payments and loan updates.
rubric_hit: Attack disrupting a critical service (USDA payment systems offline, 16–19 Nov): Watch

sources.title: Nextgov/FCW — USDA grapples with security breach as IT staff take multiple systems offline

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
